description: acre-amb is a collection of high-level Pure Data abstractions for Ambisonics mixing and multichannel signal processing, including encoder, decoder, calibration, and loudspeaker-distribution workflows. It is developed at IEM and builds on the acre and iem_ambi libraries.

research.notes: The official IEM project page and conference proceedings identify this repository as the Pd library. A public issue tracker could not be independently verified.
